description:
FREE. No API key, no balance, nothing is ordered. Call this FIRST whenever someone asks how to tell if a Chinese supplier, factory or company address is real. Returns the five checks they can do themselves from a desk for nothing — and, for each one, what it proves and **what it does not prove** — plus the three questions that only someone standing on that street can answer. Suggesting a paid site visit before the free checks wastes the user's money.
免费、不需要密钥、不会下任何单。有人问"怎么确认一家中国供应商/工厂/地址是不是真的"时**先调这个**：返回他自己坐在电脑前就能免费做的五件事，每件都写清楚证明了什么、**证明不了什么**，以及剩下哪三个问题只有到现场的人能答。

subject.description: Optional. The company name or address being checked, used only to address the answer to it. **Nothing is looked up** — that is why this tool is free. 可选。只用来让这段话有个主语，我们不会去查它。

name: what_can_i_check_myself
title: 先别花钱：你自己免费能查什么
